narr: Scattered thunderstorms along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central Virginia.
ev: Ellwood Avenue was closed near North Hamilton Street due to flash flooding.
Monument Avenue near Kent Road was closed due to flash flooding.
Road was closed due to flash flooding.
Two swift water rescues were reported along the 4000 Block of West Broad Street.
High water was reported on Hull Street Road near Bellson Park Drive.
Spotter reported fast moving water on Pemberton Road near Interstate 64.
High water was reported at the intersection of East River Road and Dupuy Avenue.
High water was reported along Whitehead Road.
